snippet.title: Nightholme | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Nightholme. Team up with 2 allies to hunt a monstrous Gloomfiend in a city consumed by decay. Rival hunters stalk the same prey-stay hidden and finish the hunt, or stalk them instead. Channel corruption to become a Grimspawn, but each shift drags you closer to madness. Survive. Escape with the Seed.

The gameplay footage frame rate is reduced to 24FPS to match the frame rate of the CG part.
Coming to Steam and Consoles.

Nightholme Key Features:
- A Different Kind of PvPvE: Forget domination and gunfights, there are no weapons in Nightholme. You are the weapon. The horror comes from being both predator and prey, hunted by monsters… and other players.
- Grimrunners & Transformations: Play as a cursed bounty hunter known as a Grimrunner. Drink Nocturn, a dangerous potion that grants monstrous power at the cost of your sanity. Each transformation changes your abilities, strengths, and playstyle.
- Living, Corrupted City: Explore a vast urban world filled with verticality, interiors, and pitch-black corners where you can vanish, or sense another player just out of sight. Routes twist, enemies evolve, and no two hunts are ever the same.
- Tension Over Chaos: Each session is its own story. You start weak, grow stronger mid-match (like a MOBA), and decide when to risk everything for the final kill. Strategy and fear drive every choice.
- World & Lore: A rich universe of cosmic horror and classic nightmares, reimagined in disturbing new ways. The deeper you dig, the stranger it gets.

Will you master the hunt, or be devoured by it?

Wishlist now: https://bit.ly/Nightholme-steam
